subject: CODEX: Error in .io_bam during CNV Calling

messages.author: e220c135eccef355
messages.subject: CODEX: Error in .io_bam during CNV Calling
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to get the raw read depth from two .bam files, and I am coming across the following error:

Error in .io_bam(.scan_bamfile, file, reverseComplement, yieldSize(file),  : 
  seqlevels(param) not in BAM header:
    seqlevels: ‘1’
    file: C:/Users/Intern/Desktop/BRCA/sorted_aln_pe_normal.bam
    index: C:/Users/Intern/Desktop/BRCA/sorted_aln_pe_normal.bam

So far, I've got the following working code:
library(CODEX)
dirPath <- c("C:/Users/Intern/Desktop/BRCA")
bamFile = list.files(dirPath, pattern = '*.bam$')
bamdir <- file.path(dirPath, bamFile)
sampname = as.matrix(c("sorted_aln_pe_normal", "sorted_aln_pe_tumor"))
bedFile = file.path(dirPath, "ngCGH_genomic_loci.bed")
chr = 1
bambedObj = getbambed(bamdir = bamdir, bedFile = bedFile, sampname = sampname, projectname = "CODEX_ngCGH", chr)
bamdir = bambedObj$bamdir; sampname = bambedObj$sampname
ref = bambedObj$ref; projectname = bambedObj$projectname; chr = bambedObj$chr

But the error follows after I type the following line of code:
coverageObj = getcoverage(bambedObj, mapqthres = 30)

Do you have any suggestions on how I should address this error?

Thank you so much in advanced,
Bianca A.

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] CODEX: Error in .io_bam during CNV Calling
parts:
Thanks for your interest in CODEX. CODEX adopts a cross-sample normalization framework and is not suitable for 2 samples. It typically needs at least ~30 samples to capture the biases and artifacts across samples and across exons.

For your error, it is due to scanBam(), which is not from CODEX (CODEX uses this to get exonic coverage). Is you bam aligned in hg38? CODEX by default is hg19. If you want to use hg38, see section "CODEX for hg38?" in our GitHub page here https://github.com/yuchaojiang/CODEX .

Hello,

My .bam file is aligned in hg38. Following your suggestions, I adapted the version of CODEX I am currently using to hg38 by typing the following code:

source("https://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38")

library(CODEX)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

However, I am still receiving the same error after I type in all of my prior working code. Do you think there is something wrong with the formats within my .bam files? Or something wrong with my written code?

Thank you in advanced,
Bianca A.

I am not sure. This part of the code has been used very extensively, both by our group and other users. It is hard for me to tell what is wrong just by the error message. I recommend go into the get coverage function and run it line by line to see what is wrong.

I agree that maybe your bam header isn't correctly formatted.

Yuchao

Yes these two need to be concordant. However Im not sure if this is the reason that leads to the error. Also just want to remind you that CODEX has to be applied to a cohort of at least ~30 samples.
Cheers,
Yuchao
